def solution():
    # Define variables
    face_value = 100
    annual_coupon_rate = 0.05
    payment_frequency = 1
    spot_rates = [0.0486, 0.0495, 0.0565]
    z_spread = 0.0234

    # Calculate the annual coupon payment
    coupon_payment = (face_value * annual_coupon_rate) / payment_frequency

    # Discount each cash flow using the spot rate plus the Z-spread
    bond_value = (
        coupon_payment / (1 + spot_rates[0] + z_spread) ** 1
        + coupon_payment / (1 + spot_rates[1] + z_spread) ** 2
        + (coupon_payment + face_value)
        / (1 + spot_rates[2] + z_spread) ** 3
    )

    # Return the bond value rounded to three decimal places
    return round(bond_value, 3)
